description: Improve sensor connection reliability with automatic reconnection, connection quality monitoring, and multi-sensor management. Reduce sensor discovery time and handle disconnections gracefully.

phases.name: Enhanced Discovery & Fast Connection
phases.description: Optimize sensor discovery to complete within 30 seconds with improved device detection

subtasks.title: Add parallel BLE/ANT+ discovery
subtasks.description: Implement concurrent scanning for BLE and ANT+ sensors to reduce total discovery time. Both protocols should scan simultaneously rather than sequentially.
subtasks.acceptance: BLE and ANT+ discovery run concurrently when both are enabled
subtasks.notes: Implemented concurrent BLE/ANT+ discovery using tokio::join! for true parallelism. Added ParallelDiscoveryResult struct, start_concurrent_discovery() method, and comprehensive unit tests.

subtasks.title: Implement device caching for fast reconnection
subtasks.description: Cache previously connected device information to enable faster reconnection without full discovery. Store device addresses, names, and protocols for known sensors.
subtasks.acceptance: Known sensors reconnect within 5 seconds without full discovery
subtasks.notes: Implemented SensorCache module with CachedSensor struct for storing device information. Cache persists to JSON file and integrates with SensorManager for fast reconnection. Added fast_reconnect_cached() method and cache management APIs. Comprehensive unit tests added.

subtasks.title: Add progressive discovery timeout
subtasks.description: Implement progressive timeout that starts aggressive scanning then extends if needed. Initial 10s aggressive scan, then continue if sensors still being found.
subtasks.acceptance: Discovery completes in 10-30 seconds based on sensor activity
subtasks.notes: Implemented progressive timeout for sensor discovery. Added ProgressiveTimeoutConfig with configurable initial scan (10s), extension periods (5s), and max time (30s). Added ProgressiveTimeoutState to track discovery progress. Integrated with SensorManager to automatically extend scanning when sensors are being discovered and stop early when idle. Added preset configurations (fast, thorough, disabled). Created comprehensive unit tests.

subtasks.title: Implement priority-based connection queue
subtasks.description: When multiple sensors discovered, connect to primary sensors first (trainers, power meters) before secondary (HR, cadence).
subtasks.acceptance: Trainer and power meter connect before heart rate sensor

phases.name: Robust Automatic Reconnection
phases.description: Improve automatic reconnection with exponential backoff and intelligent retry logic

subtasks.title: Implement exponential backoff for reconnection
subtasks.description: Replace fixed delay reconnection with exponential backoff. Start at 1s, double each attempt up to 30s max. Reset on successful connection.
subtasks.acceptance: Reconnection delays follow exponential pattern: 1s, 2s, 4s, 8s, 16s, 30s

subtasks.title: Add connection health monitoring
subtasks.description: Track connection health based on data reception rate. Trigger proactive reconnection if data stops arriving before BLE disconnect notification.
subtasks.acceptance: Stale connections (no data for 5s) trigger reconnection before BLE timeout

subtasks.title: Implement reconnection state machine
subtasks.description: Create proper state machine for connection lifecycle: Disconnected -> Connecting -> Connected -> Reconnecting. Handle edge cases and transitions cleanly.
subtasks.acceptance: All state transitions handled correctly, no invalid state combinations

subtasks.title: Add persistent reconnection across app restarts
subtasks.description: Save connection state to enable reconnection to last-known sensors on app restart. Automatically attempt to reconnect to previously connected sensors.
subtasks.acceptance: App restarts automatically reconnect to previously connected sensors

phases.name: Connection Quality Monitoring & UI
phases.description: Implement connection quality indicators and expose them in the UI

subtasks.title: Create ConnectionQuality tracking module
subtasks.description: Track RSSI, data rate, packet loss rate, and latency for each connected sensor. Calculate overall connection quality score (0-100).
subtasks.acceptance: ConnectionQuality struct tracks RSSI, data rate, and computes quality score

subtasks.title: Add RSSI polling for connected sensors
subtasks.description: Periodically poll RSSI values for connected BLE sensors. Update connection quality metrics every 2 seconds.
subtasks.acceptance: RSSI values updated every 2 seconds for connected BLE sensors

subtasks.title: Create ConnectionQualityIndicator UI widget
subtasks.description: Visual indicator showing connection quality with signal bars (1-4 bars), color coding (green/yellow/red), and tooltip with details.
subtasks.acceptance: Connection quality displayed as signal bars with appropriate colors

subtasks.title: Integrate quality indicators into sensor setup screen
subtasks.description: Add connection quality indicators to the sensor setup screen for each connected sensor. Show warnings for poor connections.
subtasks.acceptance: Sensor setup screen shows quality indicators and warns on poor connections

subtasks.title: Add quality indicator to ride HUD
subtasks.description: Show minimal connection quality indicator during active rides. Flash warning when connection quality degrades.
subtasks.acceptance: HUD shows sensor connection quality with visual warning on degradation

phases.name: Sensor Conflict Resolution
phases.description: Handle dual-protocol sensors and multi-sensor conflicts gracefully

subtasks.title: Implement DualProtocolDetector
subtasks.description: Detect when a sensor is available on both BLE and ANT+ by matching device names and serial numbers. Create bindings between dual-protocol instances.
subtasks.acceptance: Sensors with same name on BLE and ANT+ are detected as dual-protocol

subtasks.title: Add protocol preference storage
subtasks.description: Store user's preferred protocol (BLE vs ANT+) for each dual-protocol sensor. Persist preference and use on reconnection.
subtasks.acceptance: Protocol preference saved and used automatically on reconnection

subtasks.title: Implement sensor conflict detector
subtasks.description: Detect when multiple sensors provide the same data type (e.g., two power meters). Alert user and allow selection of primary sensor.
subtasks.acceptance: Conflicts detected when multiple sensors provide same data type

subtasks.title: Create conflict resolution dialog UI
subtasks.description: UI dialog to resolve sensor conflicts. Show both sensors, allow user to select primary, with option to remember choice.
subtasks.acceptance: Conflict dialog allows selection of primary sensor

subtasks.title: Add automatic primary sensor failover
subtasks.description: When primary sensor disconnects, automatically promote secondary sensor if available. Notify user of failover.
subtasks.acceptance: Secondary sensor automatically becomes primary on disconnect

phases.name: Power Meter Pairing Improvements
phases.description: Improve power meter discovery and pairing consistency

subtasks.title: Add power meter wake-up detection
subtasks.description: Power meters often need pedaling to wake up. Detect this and prompt user to pedal if power meter not found but expected.
subtasks.acceptance: User prompted to pedal if saved power meter not discovered

subtasks.title: Implement extended discovery for power meters
subtasks.description: Power meters may take longer to advertise. Extend discovery time specifically for power meters if user has one saved.
subtasks.acceptance: Discovery extends up to 45s when looking for saved power meter

subtasks.title: Add calibration reminder system
subtasks.description: Track last calibration date for power meters. Remind user to calibrate if not done recently (configurable, default 7 days).
subtasks.acceptance: Calibration reminder shown if power meter not calibrated in 7+ days

subtasks.title: Implement zero-offset calibration flow
subtasks.description: Guided UI flow for power meter zero-offset calibration. Support both manual and automatic calibration commands.
subtasks.acceptance: User can perform zero-offset calibration through guided UI

subtasks.title: Create integration test for full discovery flow
subtasks.description: End-to-end test covering discovery, connection, data reception, and graceful disconnection.
subtasks.acceptance: Integration test passes for full sensor lifecycle

subtasks.title: Add reconnection stress test
subtasks.description: Test rapid connect/disconnect cycles to ensure stability. Verify no resource leaks or crashes.
subtasks.acceptance: 100 rapid reconnection cycles complete without errors

subtasks.title: Update sensor CLI commands
subtasks.description: Add CLI commands for testing connection quality, forcing reconnection, and viewing sensor diagnostics.
subtasks.acceptance: CLI commands available for sensor diagnostics and testing

subtasks.title: Add troubleshooting documentation
subtasks.description: Document common connection issues and resolutions. Add in-app troubleshooting tips.
subtasks.acceptance: Troubleshooting tips displayed when connection issues detected

acceptance_criteria: Sensor discovery completes in under 30 seconds
notes: Existing codebase has foundation for discovery and reconnection. Focus on improving reliability, adding quality monitoring, and better UX for conflict resolution.
